Read FF #36 + your stage-mirror-then-decom comment. The pivot mirrors well here — dstrader actually already has a paper-trading profile, which makes the parallel-run window almost free. Drafted the equivalent plan-change comment for `dstrader-aws#18` below. Review it; I'll post once you ack.

## Draft comment for `dstrader-aws#18`

> ## 🔄 Plan change (2026-05-26): stage-mirror-then-decom instead of in-place prod cutover
>
> Mirroring FamilyFund #36's pivot. The current draft `docs/security/PROD-CUTOVER-RUNBOOK.md` (in worktree `bridge-cse_01YNBzaec8QHhqgG4qpSv65K`, not yet committed) follows the in-place pattern — Phase 3b flips the live prod compose service to `SECRETS_BACKEND=sops`, Phase 4 re-clones the prod host from the new origin. Replacing that with:
>
> 0. **Full prod backup first** — DB dump (FamilyFund DB on spirit), `~/.gnupg` keyring, all `*.encr` property files, current `docker-compose.{yml,prod.yml}` rendered values, `/var/log/dstrader/prod/` snapshot, current `start_dstrader.sh` + cron entry, the existing `$DSTRADER_ROOT/dstrader-docker` checkout (still on dirty origin). Stored offline, not on `spirit`. Rollback floor for everything below.
> 1. **Stand up a fresh stage-mirror stack on `spirit`** from the new clean origin (`jdtogni78/dstrader-docker`), separate compose project name, separate paths, **paper-trading mode** (port 4002 — existing stage profile). Same Dockerfile as prod.
>    - **Filesystem isolation is mandatory** (same host as live prod). Namespace every host path: bind mounts, named volumes, log dirs, backup dirs, VNC port, MariaDB volume. Targets to audit on `spirit`: the dstrader checkout dir, MariaDB data volume, `/var/log/dstrader/{prod,stage-mirror}/`, `~/familyfund_db_backups/`, VNC display number, `~/.config/sops/age/` (shared read-only is fine), `~/.gnupg` (old stack only).
> 2. **No prod DB restore needed** — dstrader's state-of-record is at IB. Local "state" is portfolios JSON (tracked in git), encrypted property files (will be re-encrypted under SOPS for the new stack), and run-log history (no need to carry forward). FamilyFund DB stays with FamilyFund's own cutover.
> 3. **Fresh `secrets/{stage,prod}/*.sops`** under the spirit age recipient. New stack is born on SOPS+age; **old stack stays on GPG** until decom — no flip on the live service. The IB credential used here is the rotated, least-privileged user from #10 + #12 (the standup *is* the rotation).
> 4. **Parallel-run window — both stacks run, N days.** Old prod cron keeps driving live trading on the old stack/old origin. New stack runs **paper-mode** daily on an offset schedule (e.g. +30min) or via manual `start_dstrader.sh restart stage`; verify: SOPS decrypt clean, auto-login isUp, runtime_dlgs healthy, strategy outputs match prod's portfolios, paper orders shape-match what prod placed live. Defines "100% working."
> 5. **Cutover:** take another fresh prod backup → pause prod cron → final GPG-mode prod run completes → swap cron entry to the new stack's `start_dstrader.sh restart prod` path → first live SOPS+age run on the new stack → verify a green scheduled run.
> 6. **Decom old stack:** stop old containers, retain a final logs+state snapshot offline (in addition to Step 0), revoke the old GPG passphrase / drop `~/.gnupg` bind mount, remove the old `$DSTRADER_ROOT/dstrader-docker` checkout (dirty-origin clone), archive image tag.
>
> ### Ticket impact
> | # | New status | Why |
> |---|---|---|
> | **#7** age key on spirit | Unchanged | Still Phase 1 prereq; both stage-mirror + cutover need it. |
> | **#10** rotate IB/mail creds → SOPS | **Folded into standup** | Rotation happens *as* the new stack is built (Step 3); no separate window. |
> | **#11** cut prod over to SOPS, retire GPG | **Reframed** | No in-place flip. Becomes: the new stack is born on SOPS; GPG-retirement code drop (`docker-compose.yml` `~/.gnupg` mount, `dstrader.passphrase` plumbing, `gpg_decr`/`gpg_encr`, the `SECRETS_BACKEND=gpg` fallback) lands *after* decom in Step 6. |
> | **#15** re-clone prod host from new origin | **Superseded** | No re-clone-in-place. The new stack *is* a fresh clone from the new origin in a separate path; cutover is a cron-entry swap, not a remote re-point. |
> | **#12** IB least-priv user | Unchanged | The credential that gets vaulted in `secrets/prod/auto_login.properties.sops` is the restricted user from day one. |
> | **#8** de-hardcode compose DB creds | ✅ Closed | Already landed (commits `7b0b2c7`, `1afb6b9`). Epic body still shows Open — to fix. |
> | **#16** flip visibility | **Unblocked sooner** | Hard gate is the final audit on the live remote, not the prod cutover. The flip can happen as soon as the audit signs off, independent of the stage-mirror work. |
> | **#17** enable CodeQL post-flip | Unchanged | Still depends on #16. |
>
> ### New work to file (sub-tickets under this epic)
> - [ ] **Pre-flight: full prod backup + verified restore drill** (Step 0; gates everything else)
> - [ ] **Filesystem-isolation audit on `spirit`** — enumerate every host path the live prod stack touches; design `prod/` vs `stage-mirror/` namespacing; pick a distinct VNC display + container/volume name prefix; document in a runbook
> - [ ] Stage-mirror compose project on `spirit` (separate project name, ports, container names, namespaced volumes/logs)
> - [ ] `secrets/{stage,prod}/*.sops` built from rotated #10 outputs + #12 restricted user
> - [ ] Parallel-run acceptance checklist (what "100% working" means: SOPS decrypt, login, runtime_dlgs, strategy parity vs prod, no log/IB-API regressions over N days)
> - [ ] Cutover runbook: pre-cutover backup, last GPG-prod run, cron-entry swap, first SOPS-prod run
> - [ ] Decom-old-stack runbook: stop, snapshot, revoke GPG, drop bind mount, archive image, delete old checkout
> - [ ] GPG-retirement code drop PR (lands after Step 6 — drops `~/.gnupg` mount, `dstrader.passphrase`, `gpg_decr`/`gpg_encr`, `SECRETS_BACKEND=gpg` fallback)
>
> ### Hard gates before cutover (not before repo-public)
> Stage-mirror work is independent of #16. The repo can go public as soon as the final audit on the live remote signs off (`HISTORY-AUDIT.md` §3 grep + gitleaks `--all` → 0 findings).
>
> ### Doc impact
> The draft `docs/security/PROD-CUTOVER-RUNBOOK.md` (uncommitted, in worktree `bridge-cse_01YNBzaec8QHhqgG4qpSv65K`) was written under the in-place pattern. To rewrite under stage-mirror-then-decom before committing, or discard and re-draft from this comment.
